description: Changed DEPTH from 8 to 6 (model_dim 384, 3 heads), all else unchanged
Changed DEPTH from 8 to 6 (n_embd=384, n_head=3), everything else unchanged, to bracket the depth optimum against the many DEPTH=10-12 proposals on the table.
Set WARMUP_RATIO from 0.0 to 0.05 (linear LR warmup over first 5% of the 5-min budget), all else unchanged from baseline (DEPTH=8).
Changed TOTAL_BATCH_SIZE from 2**19 to 2**18, doubling optimizer steps within the fixed 5-minute wall-clock budget while keeping model size (DEPTH=8) and all LRs/schedules unchanged.
Changed DEPTH from 8 to 14 (n_embd 512->896, dropped DEVICE_BATCH_SIZE 128->64 to avoid OOM); all other hyperparameters unchanged.
Kept DEPTH=8, raised ASPECT_RATIO 64->96 so n_embd goes 512->768 and n_head 4->6, widening the model instead of deepening it; complements the DEPTH-only sweeps everyone else proposed this round.
All 6 proposals this round (a0-a5) independently converged on the same change: ASPECT_RATIO=96 (baseline) + TOTAL_BATCH_SIZE 2**19->2**18. No point running it 6 times.
Increased ASPECT_RATIO from 96 to 128 (n_embd 768->1024, n_head 6->8) at fixed DEPTH=8; had to drop DEVICE_BATCH_SIZE 128->64 to avoid OOM (first attempt OOM'd at 79GB with DEVICE_BATCH_SIZE=128).
Kept ASPECT_RATIO=96 (round-0 winner), increased DEPTH from 8 to 10 (n_embd 768->1024, n_head 8), dropped DEVICE_BATCH_SIZE 128->64 to avoid OOM.

Increased ASPECT_RATIO from 96 to 128 (n_embd 768->1024, n_head 6->8), and reduced DEVICE_BATCH_SIZE from 128 to 64 to avoid OOM at the larger width (grad_accum_steps auto-doubled to keep TOTAL_BATCH_SIZE fixed).
Changed DEPTH from 8 to 10 on top of the ASPECT_RATIO=96 baseline (n_embd 768->1024, 8 heads); had to drop DEVICE_BATCH_SIZE 128->64 to avoid OOM, grad_accum doubled but TOTAL_BATCH_SIZE unchanged.

Deviated from the crowded (6-way duplicate) batch+width stack proposal; instead tested whether continuing to widen (ASPECT_RATIO 96->128, n_embd 768->1024) helps further, since 64->96 was a win. Had to drop DEVICE_BATCH_SIZE 128->64 to avoid OOM at n_embd=1024, which halves throughput/steps.
Kept ASPECT_RATIO=96 (round-0 width win), changed TOTAL_BATCH_SIZE from 2**19 to 2**18 (round-0 batch-size win), stacking both orthogonal wins together.
Changed TOTAL_BATCH_SIZE from 2**19 to 2**18 on top of ASPECT_RATIO=96 baseline, doubling optimizer steps at the wider model width.
Changed TOTAL_BATCH_SIZE from 2**19 to 2**18 on top of the ASPECT_RATIO=96 baseline (DEPTH=8), doubling optimizer steps within the fixed 5-minute budget while keeping the wider model.
Changed TOTAL_BATCH_SIZE from 2**19 to 2**18 on top of the ASPECT_RATIO=96 baseline (DEPTH=8 unchanged), doubling optimizer steps in the fixed 5-min budget while keeping the wider model.
Changed TOTAL_BATCH_SIZE from 2**19 to 2**18 on top of the ASPECT_RATIO=96 baseline (DEPTH=8), doubling optimizer steps at the wider model width; grad_accum_steps auto-halved, no other changes.

Kept ASPECT_RATIO=96 (round-0 width win), changed TOTAL_BATCH_SIZE from 2**19 to 2**18 (round-0 batch-size win) on top of it; grad_accum_steps auto-halves, doubling optimizer steps within the 5-min budget at the wider model.
Changed WEIGHT_DECAY from 0.2 to 0.0 (Muon cautious weight decay), everything else at baseline (ASPECT_RATIO=96, TOTAL_BATCH_SIZE=2^18, DEPTH=8)
Halved WEIGHT_DECAY from 0.2 to 0.1 to compensate for doubled optimizer step count since TOTAL_BATCH_SIZE halved in round 2

Changed WEIGHT_DECAY from 0.2 to 0.05 (Muon cautious weight decay), all else at baseline (ASPECT_RATIO=96, TOTAL_BATCH_SIZE=2^18, DEPTH=8)

Halved TOTAL_BATCH_SIZE from 2^18 to 2^17 and DEVICE_BATCH_SIZE from 128 to 64 (grad_accum_steps=1), doubling optimizer steps again within the fixed 5-min budget on top of ASPECT_RATIO=96, DEPTH=8, WEIGHT_DECAY=0.1 baseline.
